visible_text: 22. 若一正 n 邊形的內角較外角大 100°，則下列何者正確？ I. n 的值為 10。 II. 該多邊形每一外角均為 40°。 III. 該多邊形的反射對稱軸的數目為 9。 A. 只有 I 及 II B. 只有 I 及 III C. 只有 II 及 III D. I、II 及 III
reasoning: Since interior angle = ((n−2)·180°)/n and exterior angle = 360°/n, the condition interior = exterior + 100° gives ((n−2)·180)/n = 360/n + 100 → 180n−360 = 360+100n → 80n = 720 → n = 9. Thus I is false (n ≠ 10), II is true (each exterior = 360/9 = 40°), and III is true (a regular nonagon has 9 lines of symmetry). Therefore the correct choice is C: only II and III.
